description: Copy a file or folder on a specific instance (by id or exact name). Useful for taking a quick backup of a config file before editing it. Copying is additive and needs no confirmation, unless `overwrite` is set, which destroys whatever is already at the destination and requires `confirm: true`.

confirm.description: Required only when `overwrite` is true. Show the user what will be replaced before setting this.

from.description: File or folder to copy, from the instance root.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at `to`. Anything already there is lost, so this also requires `confirm`.

name: copy_path
title: Copy File or Folder
